proposal.name: @typescript-eslint/project-service
proposal.rationale: The component name in the SBOM used underscores (@typescript_eslint/project_service) which is not a valid npm package name. The correct npm package uses hyphens (@typescript-eslint/project-service). Verified existence via registry lookup (E1) and confirmed version 8.72.1 was published before the SBOM timestamp (E2).
